headline: New tools tackle contamination, recombination, and profiling in microbial genomics
label: Microbial Genomics Software Tools
summary: Recent preprints and an updated benchmarking platform address scalability, contamination, and classification in bacterial and metagenomic workflows.
synthesis: Across these items, the dominant thread is computational tooling that replaces ad hoc or resource-intensive steps with standardized, reproducible procedures. Verticall detects recombinant regions in bacterial genome assemblies and builds recombination-free phylogenies at scale, while Metacontam removes the need for negative controls in shotgun metagenomics through blacklist-guided network community detection and ANI-based analysis at the species level. MetaMAG Explorer recovers and dereplicates MAGs and uses them to augment Kraken2 databases. MycorrhizaTracer automates BLAST-based taxonomic classification of Sanger chromatograms for fungi and plants, and SynCom101 standardizes in silico design of synthetic microbial communities. LEMMIv2, the only item of published type, extends continuous benchmarking to metagenomic and 16S amplicon profilers with alternative taxonomies and long-read support. The remaining items are preprints, so their performance claims await independent evaluation.
